s.how: Melt 60g butter, stir in 80g flour, then whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Add 200g chopped ham, chill overnight. Shape into logs, roll in 2 beaten eggs and 150g breadcrumbs, and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve with lime.

Cut half a pineapple, 2 mangoes and half a papaya into chunks and thread onto skewers. Grill hot for a minute a side. Brush with juice of 2 limes mixed with 2 tbsp honey and sprinkle with salt and chilli flakes.

m.note: a Miami lunch on the run
m.how: Marinate 1kg pork shoulder in juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes, garlic and oregano overnight. Roast at 160C for 4 hours and slice. Layer in 4 long rolls with 150g ham, Swiss, pickles and mustard. Press in a buttered pan until crisp.

w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits mixed with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Whisk a 395g tin condensed milk with 4 yolks, the zest of 2 limes and 125ml lime juice. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, chill overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream.

d.how: For each drink, gently muddle 8 mint leaves with half a lime cut in wedges and 2 tsp sugar. Add 45ml white rum and fill with crushed ice. Top with soda water and stir from the bottom. Makes four.
